senses.gloss: m. (עָטַן) vat or pit where olives are packed until they form a viscid mass.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 9:1">Toh. IX, 1</cite> <he>זיעת המ׳</he> the (intended) exudation produced by lying in the vat, opp. <he>זיעת הקופה</he> the (unwelcome) exudation originating in the pile or basket, v. <cite ref="G00217"><he>זוּעַ</he></cite> h.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 9:9">Ib. 9</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 11:1">Tosef. ib. XI, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 6:1:2">Y. Dem. VI, 23ᵈ</cite> top <he>מ׳ של זיתים</he> a mass of olives from the vat; a. fr.
